Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. yesterday-h / yesterday-n (note + billing seeded at server now - 19 h): on open the app's lifecycle clears the note with its billing (Hospital) / archives it without billing (Nursing Home), so no card shows yesterday's 99231 / 99308 (Q16: no card for the previous note); today's Generate is billed for today's note (billingForNoteAt = today's stamp, no yesterday words) — 7/7. clock (browser a day ahead, and Pacific/Honolulu a day behind): the family always follows the template used at Generate (pre-selected and hand-picked, both contexts, 18/18 = G2 passes). Known gap (oracle knownGap TFA-92584 AC 8 = B18): the day-ahead browser shows Follow-up instead of New Admission and pre-selects SOAP / SNF follow-up, so a Generate with the pre-selection bills hospital-subsequent / snf-subsequent where a correct device bills hospital-initial / snf-initial; Honolulu matches the correct device.
Product issue: A phone whose date is a day ahead shows a New Admission as Follow-up and pre-selects SOAP / SNF follow-up, so the physician who keeps the pre-selection gets the follow-up billing family (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S27 Day boundaries: yesterday's billing is not shown as today's and is replaced at today's Generate (3.6 / 3.7), and a browser with a wrong clock bills the same family (3.8), both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • G1 Billing follows its note's retention window: Hospital note 18 h, then kept as the previous note until 36 h; Nursing Home the last two visits. … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; UAT OAT-04 (B)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • G2 Server time, not device time: a browser or phone with a wrong date or another time zone gets the same badge, the same pre-selected template and, after Generate, the same billing family as a device wi … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given yesterday-h / yesterday-n: each fixture seeded with a note, noteGeneratedAt, a billingSuggestion and billingForNoteAt at server now - 19 h (back-dated at seed time, which is seeding, not aging). …

When yesterday-*: open Post-Round before any Generate; then type today's text, Generate and open Post-Round again. clock-*: in the wrong-clock browser open the chart, read the badge and the pre-selected template, Generate with the pre-selected template; repeat with SOAP progress / SNF follow-up picked by hand

Then Before today's Generate there is no billing card for yesterday's note, or one clearly labelled as the previous note's (Q16), and never yesterday's code presented as today's; after Generate the card is today's: it quotes today's note and billingForNoteAt equals today's noteGeneratedAt. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): yesterday legs: before Generate mustNotContain yesterday's code as a current card (99231 / 99308) unless the card is labelled as the previous note's (Q16: recorded, then judged once answered); after Generate mustContainAny the family, mustNotContain the no-result texts, billingCard quotesInNote against today's note and mustNotInclude yesterday-only words ('azithromycin' / 'con …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S27

Day boundaries: yesterday's billing is not shown as today's and is replaced at today's Generate (3.6 / 3.7), and a browser with a wrong clock bills the same family (3.8), both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. yesterday-h / yesterday-n (note + billing seeded at server now - 19 h): on open the app's lifecycle clears the note with its billing (Hospital) / archives it without billing (Nursing Home), so no card shows yesterday's 99231 / 99308 (Q16: no card for the previous note); today's Generate is billed for today's note (billingForNoteAt = today's stamp, no yesterday words) — 7/7. clock (browser a day ahead, and Pacific/Honolulu a day behind): the family always follows the template used at Generate (pre-selected and hand-picked, both contexts, 18/18 = G2 passes). Known gap (oracle knownGap TFA-92584 AC 8 = B18): the day-ahead browser shows Follow-up instead of New Admission and pre-selects SOAP / SNF follow-up, so a Generate with the pre-selection bills hospital-subsequent / snf-subsequent where a correct device bills hospital-initial / snf-initial; Honolulu matches the correct device.

Product issue: A phone whose date is a day ahead shows a New Admission as Follow-up and pre-selects SOAP / SNF follow-up, so the physician who keeps the pre-selection gets the follow-up billing family (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: legs, device-clock, oracle-same-as. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
